name: Phoenix Egg summons the Phoenix as the caster's controllable pet, which follows its owner and keeps its model after its commands (#6312)
contract: #6312: Phoenix Egg 800796 effect 0 summons creature 50258 with SummonProperties 1561 (Spell.dbc EffectMiscValueB, server and client DBC alike), whose SummonProperties.dbc row is Control 2 (SUMMON_CATEGORY_PET), Title 1 (pet). A pet-category summon is a controllable guardian (Guardian constructor in TemporarySummon.cpp adds UNIT_MASK_CONTROLLABLE_GUARDIAN and charm info), so the owner's pet slot holds it and the client shows its pet bar. The reporter saw a stationary Phoenix without a pet bar. A controllable guardian on the follow command follows its owner, as the native pet bar's Follow does; Phoenix Dive and Kael's Command move or hold it only for their own durations. Asserted: after one cast the caster owns exactly one 50258 and the caster's guardian pet is that Phoenix (pet_entry reads Player::GetGuardianPet, the pet slot), and a Phoenix summoned 10 yards away comes to its owner's side (pet_distance, the 2D distance of that pet, falls from at least 6 on arrival to at most 5 yards while the owner stands still). Creature 50258's own model is display 17765 at DisplayScale 0.6 (creature_template_model); Kael's Command 800816 turns it into the egg display 20245 for the dormancy of 707060, whose DurationIndex 1 is 10 s, and the reporter saw the Phoenix stay an egg after a Phoenix Dive 706854 and long after the dormancy. Phoenix Dive needs one Ember 807533 (CasterAuraSpell), set here as fixture state. Asserted: 5 s after a dive the pet shows display 17765 at scale 0.6; after Kael's Command it shows 20245, still does 8 s later, shows 17765 at scale 0.6 again within 4 s more and then returns to its owner's side.
